title: Neko phone booking bar
description: A slim white bar pinned to the bottom of the phone screen with a soft upward shadow: the product's name and a one-line detail on the left, a blue booking button on the right. It stays tucked below the screen and slides up whenever you scroll back up past the first screen, and away again as you scroll on.
notes: phones and tablets only (hidden from 1024px); fixed to the window, so it renders nothing in place
needs JavaScript to watch the scroll direction; without it the bar stays tucked away
